title: feuilleea julibrissin

The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and alleviating stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
